beats.visual: Hi friends! Let's learn twenty colors, in English, and in French! / Colors! Yay!
Red. / Red! / Rouge. / Rouge ! / A red apple!
Orange. / Orange! / Orange. / Orange ! / An orange... orange!
Yellow. / Yellow! / Jaune. / Jaune ! / The yellow sun!
Green. / Green! / Vert. / Vert ! / A green frog!
Blue. / Blue! / Bleu. / Bleu ! / A blue balloon!
Quiz time! Which one is green? / Yes! This one is green! / Vert !
Purple. / Purple! / Violet. / Violet ! / Purple grapes. Yum!
Pink. / Pink! / Rose. / Rose ! / A pink pig!
Brown. / Brown! / Marron. / Marron ! / A brown bear... that's me!
Black. / Black! / Noir. / Noir ! / A black cat!
White. / White! / Blanc. / Blanc ! / A white cloud!
Quiz time! Which one is pink? / Yes! This one is pink! / Rose !
Gray. / Gray! / Gris. / Gris ! / A gray mouse!
Gold. / Gold! / Doré. / Doré ! / A gold star!
Silver. / Silver! / Argenté. / Argenté ! / A shiny silver key!
Turquoise. / Turquoise! / Turquoise. / Turquoise ! / A turquoise fish!
Sky blue. / Sky blue! / Bleu ciel. / Bleu ciel ! / The sky is sky blue!
Quiz time! Which one is gold? / Yes! This one is gold! / Doré !
Lime green. / Lime green! / Vert citron. / Vert citron ! / A lime green leaf!
Navy blue. / Navy blue! / Bleu marine. / Bleu marine ! / A navy blue boat!
Peach. / Peach! / Pêche. / Pêche ! / A juicy peach!
Lavender. / Lavender! / Lavande. / Lavande ! / A lavender flower!
Beige. / Beige! / Beige. / Beige ! / A yummy beige cookie!
Quiz time! Which one is peach? / Yes! This one is peach! / Pêche !
Let's say them all, together! / Red, Orange, Yellow, Green, Blue! / Purple, Pink, Brown, Black, White! / Gray, Gold, Silver, Turquoise, Sky blue! / Lime green, Navy blue, Peach, Lavender, Beige!

Et maintenant, en français ! / rouge, orange, jaune, vert, bleu ! / violet, rose, marron, noir, blanc ! / gris, doré, argenté, turquoise, bleu ciel ! / vert citron, bleu marine, pêche, lavande, beige !
What's YOUR favorite color? Bye bye, friends! / Bye bye! Au revoir!
